text: {"decision": "reject", "reason": "away_player_X11 is a field-position coordinate (small integers 3–8, one of the X1–X11/Y1–Y11 coordinate columns) rather than a player identifier—the actual player references are away_player_1..11 which hold large api ids—so its full containment in Player.id is coincidental overlap of small integers with a 1–11075 key."}
